description.en: dsh-sd-bridge-guard插件已发布，可以帮你完善提示词，提高图片质量，并做到dsh无限制生图
【已归档】上游风控持续加强、UA/请求头格式频繁变动，适配已难以为继。后续开发移步 https://github.com/functy23/dsh-workbuddy-panel
description.zh: 已归档的 WorkBuddy 模型接入插件，把 WorkBuddy 渠道接进 DSH 当模型用，现已停止维护。

description.en: 把单一会话不可能的巨任务拆成无数可验证子系统，大规模并行有纪律执行
DeepSeek Harness 한국어 플러그인 (비공식 커뮤니티 프로젝트)
DSH 网页版桌面宠物「肥鲸」——蓝发鲸鱼娘，固定在 harness 页面右下角：会眨眼、能拖拽、点击可聊天，支持语音对话、念诗说书、饭点提醒。
基于snowluma & onebot协议,面向DSH 的 AI bot养成插件，连接 QQ 与 B站，整合角色人设、情绪驱动、跨平台共享记忆、Obsidian 双向链接记忆库与听说看唱能力，配备沉浸式三维记忆星图和网页控制台
DeepSeek Harness plugin: a session cost chip in the conversation header - live token usage by bucket, peak/off-peak tariff, and a countdown to the next tariff switch.

Trim idle DeepSeek Harness session logs at startup: keep the last N windows, cut the ones the model can no longer see, and verify the result with the host's own format, session and projection validators before writing. Not context compaction: this shrinks
description.zh: 启动时自动裁掉空闲会话日志里模型早已看不到的旧窗口，先过三层校验再落盘，日志不再只增不减。

description.en: odoo-lint for DeepSeek Harness: lint and fix Odoo addons, and lint every addon file the agent edits
把「视觉伴侣页面上的提交」变成一条用户消息：用户在网页上点选、写备注、按提交，DSH 会话自动起一轮继续工作，不必回终端复述。
TinyFish-backed search and fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web) — $0 SERP and page extraction, direct or via Monid.

DeepSeek Harness LLM adapter for Qoder CN and Qoder International subscriptions, built on the official Qoder Agent SDKs. Reuses the local qoderclicn / qodercli login, shows the account quota the Qoder clients display, and exposes a fully configurable sett
让 DSH 加入 Minecraft 服务器游玩：有自己的游戏角色，能探索、建造、聊天。
看屏幕陪玩/陪看剧/陪写代码的 DSH 插件：自动截图 → 多模态理解 → 人格化台词（带情绪）→ TTS + RVC 语音朗读，支持双色桌面字幕与最多三角色陪玩。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: multimodal tools (image/audio/video/document understanding, transcription, image generation) via Gemini API or the local Antigravity CLI.
AppPackager CLI: package uni-app x projects into iOS IPA, Android APK and HarmonyOS HAP from one command, on macOS today and Windows through a Git-Bash/WSL bridge.
A safe, searchable, approval-gated Markdown knowledge vault for DeepSeek Harness.

VT UI/UX Enhancer: reversible UI/UX refinements for DeepSeek Harness — palette, elevation, control shapes and motion shipped as patches over DSH's own tokens, slots and styles. Disabling the plugin restores the shipped interface exactly.
description.zh: 把多个 DSH 插件收在一个仓库里统一维护发布，每个插件都能单独安装升级。

description.en: 质疑与投诉期限核对（按公开的政府采购质疑投诉规定核对期限与台账自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 按财政部94号令自动核对质疑与投诉期限台账，只提示差异，不替你下结论。

description.en: A desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): she lives on your real desktop (on top of your windows or inside the wallpaper), talks with you by voice and remembers you. · DSH 桌面女友：住在你真正的桌面上，能语音聊天、记得你。
Finite owner-authorized offline Linux execution with native or Docker isolation, durable audit and external revocation.
A DSH plugin that turns one provider API key into a managed pool + more built-in LLM Providers
description.zh: 把一个厂商 API Key 变成可管理的密钥池，还内置更多 LLM 厂商，省心又省钱。

description.en: Run DeepSeek Harness from anywhere: one plugin suite with SSH ops, the Git workbench, browser automation and remote access from desktop and mobile.
description.zh: 一个插件搞定 DSH 远程操作：SSH 运维、Git 工作台、浏览器自动化，电脑手机都能用。

description.en: TinyFish-backed search and fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web) — $0 SERP and page extraction, direct or via Monid.
description.zh: 给 AI 助手接上实时联网能力，免费搜索和抓取网页，每次调用零成本。

description.en: Wraps the separately installed agent-desktop CLI (`npm i -g agent-desktop`) as nine DSH tools (ad_status, ad_list_windows, ad_snapshot, ad_find, ad_click, ad_type, ad_press, ad_launch, ad_close_app) so an agent can list windows, read an accessibility tree, click a snapshot ref, type text, send keys, launch an app and close it gracefully. The plugin adds no automation logic of its own: it validates arguments, calls the CLI and returns the parsed JSON envelope, and asks the caller to take a fresh snapshot instead of retrying a stale ref, so a click never lands on a shifted target.
description.zh: 把需另行安装的 agent-desktop CLI（`npm i -g agent-desktop`）封装成 9 个 DSH 工具（ad_status、ad_list_windows、ad_snapshot、ad_find、ad_click、ad_type、ad_press、ad_launch、ad_close_app），让 Agent 直接列窗口、读无障碍树、按快照 ref 点击、输入文本、发送按键、启动与优雅关闭应用。插件本身不含自动化逻辑，只做参数校验、调用 CLI、解析 JSON 信封；ref 过期时要求调用方重新快照，不自动重试，避免误点。

description.en: arXiv paper survey assistant with a settings-page UI, a local knowledge base, a feedback loop, keyword search plus optional local-embedding semantic search, and per-paper deep-read notes. Requires a configured DSH LLM provider; semantic search and full-text deep read need an optional Python environment (pymupdf + fastembed), otherwise they fall back to keyword search or are skipped.
description.zh: arXiv 论文调研助手：设置页图形界面、本地知识库、反馈循环、关键词检索与可选的本地向量语义检索，以及逐篇深读笔记。需已配置 DSH 的 LLM 提供商；语义检索与全文深读另需可选的 Python 环境（pymupdf + fastembed），没有时语义检索退回关键词、深读跳过。

description.en: Background browser automation for DSH with an offscreen Electron window, CDP input, snapshot refs, and no focus stealing.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的后台浏览器自动化插件：离屏 Electron 窗口、CDP 输入、快照 ref，不抢焦点。

description.en: Agent preset that hands every task to a Claude Code subagent, so the session only writes the task brief, delegates and reports the result. Requires a locally installed, logged-in Claude Code.
description.zh: 一个 Agent 预设：把每个任务都交给 Claude Code 子代理执行，会话只负责写任务说明、委派与汇报结果。需本机已安装并登录 Claude Code。

description.en: Caps how many DeepSeek Harness conversations run at once, so extra conversations wait in a FIFO queue instead of piling up model requests. On Windows a bottom status strip shows physical memory, commit memory and disk usage; on other platforms only the queue and physical memory are reported. A plugins-page card changes the limit.
description.zh: 限制 DeepSeek Harness 同时运行的对话数量，超出的对话按先进先出排队，不再堆叠请求；Windows 下底部状态条显示物理内存、提交内存与磁盘占用（其它平台只有队列与物理内存），插件页卡片可随时修改上限。

description.en: A fact layer for daily heartbeat turns: diffs the curated plugin market for newly published entries and the Chinese education SRC calendars (EDUSRC rounds, Beijing education SRC seasons, the standing vulnerability-hunting exercise) for new items. Reports deltas only — the first call seeds a baseline and stays quiet.
description.zh: 给每日巡检回合提供事实层：对比插件市场注册表报新增条目，对比教育行业 SRC 页面（EDUSRC 众测、北京教育 SRC 赛季、常态化演习）报新一期活动。只报变化，首次调用只建基线、不报新增。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the Windows desktop app title bar and replaces the cold-start "loading settings" overlay with an animated boot sequence.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面端标题栏加一个重启按钮，并把冷启动时的「正在加载设置…」换成一段科技感动画。

description.en: Sidebar developer toolbox with 65 pure browser-side tools in 13 groups — JSON, code formatting, URL, encoding, hashing, encryption, text, and number/date utilities — with zero network requests. Registers as a tab in dsh-better-sidebar, which must be installed for the panel to appear.
description.zh: 侧边栏开发者工具箱，内置 13 组共 65 个纯浏览器端工具，覆盖 JSON、代码格式化、URL、编码解码、哈希、加密、文本与数字日期处理，零网络请求；面板以页签形式挂在 dsh-better-sidebar 上，需先安装该插件。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar brand mark with a custom one and registers a Vietnamese locale covering 45 namespaces and 1897 interface strings, falling back to English for anything untranslated.
description.zh: 用自定义图标替换侧边栏品牌标识，并注册一套越南语语言包，覆盖 45 个命名空间、1897 条界面文案，未翻译处回退英文。

description.en: An add-only Markdown library for DeepSeek Harness with a workspace file picker, a fixed icon grid with pointer-first hysteresis drag targeting, marquee selection and bulk folder moves, drag-to-folder and dissolve/delete folder actions, persistent move and line highlights, full-screen tabs, immersive reading, GFM tables, bookmarks, and local Mermaid/chart rendering.
description.zh: 只收主动加入的 Markdown 文档，支持工作区挑选、带指针滞回的固定网格拖拽、右键框选与批量移入文件夹、文件夹解散/删除、移动与行高亮持久标记、全屏标签页与沉浸式阅读、GFM 表格、书签，以及 Mermaid/代码块图表本地渲染。

description.en: Per-person affinity for DSH personas on a QQ channel (a QQ bridge such as dsh-onebot-qq is required — the person is identified by the QQ number in each message; on the plain web UI nothing is injected): per-user scores with daily decay, reasons history, sulking and forgiveness, plus a global mood that colors replies.
description.zh: 在 QQ 通道上给 DSH 人设按人记好感度（需先装 QQ 通道插件，如 dsh-onebot-qq；身份取自消息里的 QQ 号，纯 Web 界面下不会注入）：分数、每日衰减、理由回看、生闷气与哄好，外加影响整体语气的综合情绪。

description.en: Image understanding for DSH: describe an image and read the text in it through Zhipu GLM-4V (needs a Zhipu API key, free tier), with optional person identification through Volcengine Ark and anime-only reverse image search through SauceNAO or trace.moe (each needs its own key); ffmpeg must be installed for GIF/WebP input. Keys and the ffmpeg path are set on the plugin's own settings page.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加识图：用智谱 GLM-4V 描述图片、读图中文字（需智谱 API Key，有免费额度），可选火山方舟认人、SauceNAO / trace.moe 反查动漫原图（各需自己的 Key）；GIF/WebP 图需要装 ffmpeg。Key 与 ffmpeg 路径在插件自带的设置页里配。

description.en: Carve one sentence into a clean text-free background image — 87 illustration, anime and infographic styles, four image APIs wired in, plus prompt expansion that fills in the details you cannot describe.
description.zh: 把一句话刻成一张干净底图——87 种插画、二次元与信息图风格，四家出图接口直接接好，附描述扩写帮你补出说不清的画面细节。

description.en: Always-on-top status pill for DSH on Windows: shows each session's turn state (thinking with a running timer, waiting for approval, done, failed) above every window, collapses to a small dot while thinking continues and disappears a few seconds after a turn finishes, stacks up to three concurrent sessions side by side with a +N overflow badge, and hides itself while a fullscreen app is in front. Clicking it brings DSH to the foreground and dragging moves it; it reuses the Electron build already shipped with DSH Desktop, so nothing extra is downloaded. A settings card on the plugin page adjusts scale, mini size, position, hold times, effects and per-state visibility.
description.zh: Windows 上的 DSH 置顶状态胶囊：把每个会话的回合状态（思考并计时、等待审批、完成、失败）浮在所有窗口之上，思考持续时缩成小圆点，回合结束后几秒内消失，最多并排显示三个会话、其余折成 +N 角标，前台是全屏应用时自动隐藏。点击可把 DSH 拉到前台，拖动可改位置；复用 DSH Desktop 自带的 Electron，不额外下载。插件页里的设置卡片可调缩放、迷你尺寸、位置、收起时间、动效和各状态开关。

description.en: One shelf for WeChat Reading, GitHub book repos and your own EPUB/PDF/Markdown, with an immersive reader and AI notes.
description.zh: 把微信读书、GitHub 书库和自己的 EPUB/PDF/Markdown 收进一个书架，沉浸阅读并让 AI 解释划词。

description.en: Control a local Linux desktop from DeepSeek Harness with 19 tools: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, scroll, window, application, display and state-verification control over a native X11 session with XTEST, plus optional AT-SPI accessibility-tree reads and widget value setting. Not for Wayland. Requires xdotool on the host (XTEST input); screenshots and window control also want scrot, ffmpeg, wmctrl, xrandr and xprop, and the AT-SPI tools need python3-gi, at-spi2-core and libatk-adaptor. Missing packages can be installed from the plugin's dependency panel with sudo.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控本机 Linux 桌面，提供 19 个工具：截图、鼠标、键盘、滚动、窗口、应用、显示器与状态校验，基于原生 X11 + XTEST 会话，并可选读取 AT-SPI 无障碍树与直接给控件赋值，不适用于 Wayland。需要宿主安装 xdotool（XTEST 注入）；截图与窗口控制还需 scrot、ffmpeg、wmctrl、xrandr、xprop，AT-SPI 工具另需 python3-gi、at-spi2-core、libatk-adaptor。缺失的软件包可在插件详情页的依赖面板用 sudo 一键补装。

description.en: Embeds a private local Sub2API gateway (Sub2API + PostgreSQL + Redis via Docker) into the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with automatic local login. Windows only, with Docker Desktop and its WSL2 backend already installed; the first start pulls about 250 MB of images and needs local ports 18080 and 18081 free.
description.zh: 把一套本机私有的 Sub2API 网关（Sub2API + PostgreSQL + Redis，Docker 方式）内嵌到 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏，并自动本地登录。仅限 Windows，需已装好 Docker Desktop 与 WSL2 后端；首次启动要从 Docker Hub 拉取约 250 MB 镜像，并占用本机 18080、18081 端口。

description.en: Inventory of the MCP servers, skills and hooks a DSH profile has, plus a conversation tab reporting every tool, skill and MCP server a session actually called.
description.zh: 汇总本机已配置的 MCP 服务、SKILL 与 HOOK 清单，并在会话顶部新增一个页签，展示该会话实际调用过的每个工具、技能与 MCP 服务。

description.en: Zhinao (second brain) for DeepSeek Harness: Markdown-authoritative layered memory (L1 long-term model gated by user confirmation / L2 knowledge with mandatory sources / L3 recent status under daily quotas), a local recall ledger explaining every injection, lifecycle engine with weekly review and a Web panel. First-run wizard initializes a blank brain, adopts an existing Zhinao directory read-only, or fills in only missing skeleton files; existing files are never touched.
description.zh: 智脑（第二大脑）—— DeepSeek Harness 的 Markdown 权威记忆插件：分层记忆（L1 长期模型经用户确认 / L2 知识必须留源 / L3 近况每日配额），本地召回账本可解释每次注入，生命周期引擎带周回顾与 Web 面板。首次运行向导支持空白脑新建、只读接管现有智脑目录、或仅补齐缺失骨架文件，均不改动已有文件。

description.en: Adds a plugin market entry button to the left sidebar that opens the installed market in a main panel.
description.zh: 在左侧栏添加插件市场入口按钮，点击后在主面板打开已安装的插件市场。

description.en: Local searchable archive of DSH chat history: decodes the multi-frame zstd session logs (thousands of concatenated frames), extracts user and assistant text into SQLite, and exposes sync / search / stats tools. Idempotent imports, no external service, nothing leaves the disk.
description.zh: 把会话日志归档成本地可检索的聊天库：逐帧解码几千帧相接的 zstd 日志，抽取 user/assistant 文本入 SQLite，提供同步/检索/统计三个工具。幂等导入，不依赖外部服务，数据不出本机。

description.en: Waifu mode for QQ: splits every reply into several short chat bubbles with a human-like typing delay, drops trailing periods, and keeps tables and code blocks intact. Works by patching @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot in the desktop profile: run node outbound/apply-patch.mjs once, set im-qqbot streaming: false, then restart — until then only the waifu_* tools work.
description.zh: 让 AI 在 QQ 里一句一句发消息：把每条回复拆成几个气泡、按字数给打字停顿、句末不留句号；表格和代码块整条不切。做法是给 desktop profile 里的 @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 发送链打补丁：先手动运行一次 node outbound/apply-patch.mjs、把 im-qqbot 的 streaming 设为 false 并重启；在此之前只有 waifu_* 工具可用。

description.en: Compare two or three answers in one session and drop chosen turns from every later model request.
description.zh: 在同一会话里对比两三次回答，并从之后每次模型请求中剔除指定的轮次。

description.en: Agent-facing keyword search over local DSH session logs: session_search returns matching sessions with timestamps and excerpts, session_read dumps one conversation, and both skip injected context such as memory snapshots; no index is built.
description.zh: 面向模型的历史会话关键字检索：session_search 返回命中的会话、时间与上下文片段，session_read 导出单个会话的对话，两者都跳过记忆快照等注入内容；不建索引。

description.en: Names sessions as a category plus a short topic. A sidebar action reads the conversation, asks its model for the pair, and pre-fills an editable title; a smart_rename_session tool gives the same naming to the agent, which renames the session it runs in when the topic moves on.
description.zh: 把会话命名成「分类 · 主题」：侧边栏菜单读对话、让会话所用的模型给出分类与主题并预填可编辑的标题；另有一个 smart_rename_session 工具，让 agent 在话题切换时自己改名。

description.en: Adds a sidebar panel that browses the 设记 Design Memory component library by asset type, with live previews, design tokens, and copyable HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Component pages ship with the plugin; fonts and images load from the public library site.
description.zh: 在侧边栏增加设记 Design Memory 组件库面板：按资产类型浏览，支持实时预览、查看设计参数并复制 HTML/CSS/JS。组件页面随插件打包，字体与图片从公开资源库站点加载。

description.en: Controls the Browser panel DSH renders in the right Sidebar: numbered refs from a snapshot, click/type/press/select/scroll, query-scoped reads and change diffs, up to 12 steps in one call, and multi-tab focus/close.
description.zh: 控制 DSH 右栏内置 Browser 的 Agent 插件：快照返回编号控件，支持点击/输入/按键/选择/滚动，按问题检索阅读与变化对比，一次调用最多 12 步，并可切换和关闭多个标签。

description.en: Adds three switchable sidebar layouts to DeepSeek Harness and a settings control for the startup default layout.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供三种可切换的侧栏布局，并在插件详情页设置启动时的默认布局。

description.en: Adds a one-click "send to SiYuan" action to delivered Markdown files: a button on each delivered-file card and on the document-preview toolbar, plus a `siyuan_send` agent tool, all posting through the SiYuan kernel HTTP API into a self-hosted notebook. Existing notes are never overwritten — a repeated title gets a timestamp suffix — and the API token stays in the host credential store rather than in settings files or the browser.
description.zh: 给交付的 Markdown 文件加上一键「发送到思源」：交付文件卡片与文档预览工具栏各有一个按钮，另有一个 `siyuan_send` 智能体工具，统一走思源内核 HTTP API 写入自建笔记本。已有笔记绝不覆盖——重名自动加时间戳——API token 只存在宿主凭据库里，不落设置文件、也不发给浏览器。

description.en: Hold Space to record and release to transcribe and send, without focusing the composer first. Esc cancels and window blur auto-cancels. Requires the official voice-input bundle (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`) enabled with its speech model downloaded; otherwise Space is left alone.
description.zh: 按住空格录音、松手自动识别并发送，不用先点输入框。按 Esc 可取消，切换窗口自动取消。需先启用官方「语音输入」Bundle（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`）并下载好语音模型，否则插件不接管空格。

description.en: Layered context management: at each turn end older tool output becomes a deterministic card, the model can fold older ranges into its own summaries in up to three tiers (compress), and every original is archived locally for decompress and search_context. Works alongside DSH-Mem0: superseded runtime-context snapshots (such as recalled memories) are never archived, carded or folded, and are replaced by a one-line placeholder at turn end when the prompt cache is already broken, when the saving outweighs the cache miss, or above 75% of the window; a strataBudget service (pressure, allowance, countTokens) and a strata/fold-landed event are provided for other context plugins; strata_status warns when DSH's automatic compaction is off or its official summary keeps failing. Its L1 layer, archive rotation, prune guard and preset takeover are forked from dsh-live-compact 1.0.6 (MIT); uninstall dsh-live-compact or billion-context first — they replace the same compaction rows and Strata will not take over while either is installed.
description.zh: 分层上下文管理：每轮结束时把较早的工具输出替换成确定性卡片；模型可以用 compress 把较早的范围折叠成自己写的摘要，最多三级；所有原文都存在本地，可用 decompress 和 search_context 取回。可与 DSH-Mem0 同时使用：过期的运行时上下文快照（比如召回的记忆）不存档、不切卡、不折叠；在前缀缓存已经失效、清理的收益超过缓存损失，或上下文超过窗口 75% 时，于轮末换成一行占位；为其他上下文插件提供 strataBudget 服务（pressure、allowance、countTokens）和 strata/fold-landed 事件；DSH 自动压缩没有启用、或官方摘要连续失败时，strata_status 会给出警告。其 L1 层、存档轮换、裁剪保护与预设接管分叉自 dsh-live-compact 1.0.6（MIT）；请先卸载 dsh-live-compact 或 billion-context——它们替换同一行压缩配置，装着任一者时 Strata 不会接管。

description.en: Passive recorder that replays the main agent and every subagent on one timeline, flags repeated calls, loops, recurring errors and truncated output, and writes an AI cause-and-effect review on demand.
description.zh: 被动记录器，把主 agent 与所有 subagent 放在同一条时间线上回放，标出重复调用、循环、反复出现的错误和输出截断，并可按需生成 AI 前因后果复盘。

description.en: Declares two model routes in the llm-pi-ai settings section — a TLPro gateway and Z.ai's GLM-5.3 endpoint — with per-model context windows, output caps and reasoning-effort ladders, so the stock model picker can select and tune them. Requires your own TLPRO_API_KEY and a Z.ai coding-plan ZAI_API_KEY; the patch replaces the whole llm-pi-ai row config.
description.zh: 在 llm-pi-ai 设置节声明两条模型路由——TLPro 网关与 Z.ai 的 GLM-5.3 端点——逐模型给出上下文窗口、输出上限与推理档位，让自带的模型选择器可以选中并调节它们。需自备 TLPRO_API_KEY 与 Z.ai 编程套餐的 ZAI_API_KEY；该补丁会整体替换 llm-pi-ai 行的配置。

description.en: Blocks the end of a turn while temporary files from that turn are still lying around: it registers a listener on the serial agent/turn-stopping hook and, if anything is left, steers the model with the file list and two ways out — delete them, or justify each one and move it somewhere deliberate. Candidates come from two narrow temp-file sources, plus a backup-retention channel that is on by default and flags excess .bak copies of files touched this turn. The first is the .agent-tmp/ convention directory under the session cwd: whatever is left in it is reported outright, because that directory exists only for throwaway files. The second is the paths this turn actually wrote, captured through the fs/write-intent hook; those are reported only when they sit under that cwd, fall outside .git, node_modules, .tmp-sessions and out, match a temp-file pattern, and the file is still present — which is what keeps junk already sitting in the workspace from being resurrected as a complaint about this turn. One steer per turn, subagent sessions skipped, nothing deleted by the plugin in the default steer mode (only the opt-in mode: prune deletes backups), and the check is readdir plus stat only.
description.zh: 临时文件没清完，这一轮就结束不了：在串行的 agent/turn-stopping 钩子上挂一个监听器，发现残留就把文件清单 steer 回模型，并给两条出路——删掉，或者逐条说明理由再挪到明确位置。候选有两处很窄的临时件来源，另有一条默认开启的备份保留通道：本轮碰过的 .bak 副本超过 keep 份会被列出。第一处是会话 cwd 下的 .agent-tmp/ 约定目录：留在里面的文件一律直接报出，因为这个目录的存在意义就是装可丢的东西。第二处是本轮经 fs/write-intent 钩子真实写入的路径，这些还要同时满足：在那个 cwd 之下、不落在 .git / node_modules / .tmp-sessions / out 里、命中临时件模式、且文件此刻仍在，才会报——正因如此，工作区里早就躺着的垃圾不会被翻出来当成本轮的问题。每轮只拦一次，子会话跳过，默认的 steer 模式下插件自己不删任何文件（只有显式选 mode: prune 才会删备份），检查只做 readdir 与 stat。

description.en: Delegates independent tasks from DeepSeek Harness to the local OpenAI Codex CLI and returns the result to the current conversation. Provides four tools (task execution, status check, danger-mode toggle, enable/disable switch), enforces a real-path working-directory whitelist with symlink-escape protection, defaults to Codex workspace-write sandbox mode, passes the task body as a single argv argument to avoid shell injection, kills the whole Codex process group on timeout or cancel, and caps output length. Requires Node.js >= 20 and a Codex CLI build supporting codex exec.
description.zh: 把独立任务从 DeepSeek Harness 委派给本机 OpenAI Codex CLI 执行，并把结果返回当前会话。提供四个工具（任务执行、状态检查、危险模式开关、启停开关），强制真实路径白名单并做软链逃逸防护，默认使用 Codex workspace-write 沙箱模式，任务正文以单个 argv 参数传递避免 shell 注入，超时或取消时终止完整 Codex 进程组，并限制输出长度。需要 Node.js >= 20 和支持 codex exec 的 Codex CLI。

description.en: Ask a vision-capable model about a local image from any session, including sessions whose own model is text-only. On the default path the plugin calls the host's route in-process with ctx.llm.stream(), so the host's credentials stay inside its provider adapters; only the optional direct/custom OpenAI-compatible routes read one key (from the plugin config or an apiKeyRef into ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml).
description.zh: 任意会话都能让视觉模型读本地图片，包括会话本身用的是纯文本模型的情况。默认路径下插件通过 ctx.llm.stream() 在进程内调用宿主路线，宿主凭据留在 provider 适配器里；只有可选的 direct/自定义 OpenAI 兼容路线会读取密钥（来自插件配置或 apiKeyRef 指向的 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml）。

description.en: Security review for DSH plugins: reads the manifest, install hooks, native dependencies and source for network egress, dangerous APIs and credential paths, cross-checks the curated market registry, and returns a 100-point verdict with itemised findings. Read-only — it never executes the audited code.
description.zh: 装插件前的安全体检：读 package.json、安装期脚本、原生依赖与源码，扫外联域名、危险 API、凭据路径，再交叉核对市场的能力声明与红线，给出 100 分制评级与逐条发现。只读，不执行被审计代码。

description.en: Material 3 Expressive theme layered over the built-in light/dark/system preferences, mapping every host alias token to colour roles generated from the official M3 colour library, plus expressive shape, motion, M3 menu surfaces and touch-browser ergonomics.
description.zh: 叠加在宿主浅色/深色/跟随系统偏好之上的 Material 3 Expressive 主题：把宿主全部别名 token 映射到官方算色库生成的颜色角色，并补上方圆轮廓、动效、M3 弹层菜单与触屏适配。

description.en: Turns your local WeChat group chats into a followable todo board: a three-column kanban (todo / doing / needs you) with LLM summaries, automatic flagging of messages that @-mention or reply to you, drag-to-change status, and local-only storage. Needs a local Python 3 with sqlcipher3 and zstandard, plus the existing rion-wechat-reader config.json and keys.json for the WeChat databases; the plugin does not extract the keys itself, and summaries send the quoted chat text to the model you choose.
description.zh: 把本地微信群聊变成可跟进的待办看板：三栏（待办 / 进行中 / 需要你）配模型总结、自动标出 @ 你或回复你的消息、拖拽改状态、仅本地存储。需本机 Python 3 并装好 sqlcipher3 与 zstandard，且已有 rion-wechat-reader 的 config.json 与 keys.json（插件不负责取密钥）；总结时会把群聊原文发给所选模型。

description.en: Shared editable Excalidraw whiteboards with per-session multi-board management, quick navigation, incremental AI edits, curves, polylines, and image exports.
description.zh: 人机共享的可编辑 Excalidraw 白板，支持同会话多白板管理、快速跳转、AI 增量编辑、曲线折线和图片导出。

description.en: Audits and evolves agent context at four scopes: a single repository, a group of related repos, a knowledge hub, or the whole machine. Discovers projects, instruction files, skills, tools, knowledge, project state, evidence and credential references; reports drift, duplicate facts, broken pointers, budget overruns, unindexed knowledge, stale state and unregistered credentials; scores each scope on the dimensions that belong to it; and turns findings into reviewable migration plans that back up every file before moving it. Also scaffolds a deliberately small hub for durable knowledge and project state. Ships a stdlib-only Python CLI plus two skills, with credentials referenced by path and never printed. Requires Python 3.9+ (stdlib only) and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer.
description.zh: 按四个层级审计与治理 agent 上下文：单个仓库、一组相关仓库、知识中枢、整台机器。发现项目、指令文件、技能、工具、知识、项目状态、证据与凭据引用；报告漂移、同一事实多个家、断链、预算超限、未索引知识、过期状态与未登记凭据；每个层级只算属于它的维度；并把问题转成可复核的迁移计划，每个文件移动前先备份。还能生成一个刻意保持精简的 Hub，承载长期知识与项目状态。包含零依赖 Python CLI 和两个 skill，凭据只引用路径、从不打印。需要 Python 3.9+（仅标准库）与 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 或更新版本。

description.en: Electron browser with two faces. For agents it is a runtime: a daemon hands out port leases so several agents drive isolated, profile-backed sessions (24 session tools — navigate, act, observe, screenshot, batch runs — plus network_capture/responses for reading XHR/fetch bodies through a real browser), and it needs no window. For demos it splits a web walkthrough into a Stage window for the audience and a hidden Recorder that produces 1080p30 video with evidence files over CDP, without forking the browser engine; flows are scripted as scene.yaml packages driven from a Director console plus a loopback control API on 127.0.0.1:7317; headless recording shows no window, takes no focus and stays out of the Dock. Requires Node 22.12+ on the 22 line, 24.x, or 26+ (the 23 and 25 lines are excluded).
description.zh: Electron 浏览器，两种形态。对 agent 是运行时：守护进程按端口发放租约，多个 agent 可同时驱动隔离且可复用登录态的 session（24 个 session 工具——导航、交互、观察、截图、批量执行——外加 network_capture/responses，用真浏览器取 XHR/fetch 响应体），全程不需要窗口。对演示是舞台：把网页演示拆成给观众看的 Stage 与隐藏录制的 Recorder（CDP 抓帧、1080p30 出片、证据文件），不 fork 浏览器内核；流程编排成 scene.yaml 场景包，由 Director 控制台与 127.0.0.1:7317 本地控制 API 驱动；无头录制不显示窗口、不抢焦点、不占 Dock。需要 Node 22.12+（22 线）、24.x 或 26+（不含 23 与 25）。

description.en: Adds an `ocsr` skill and an `ocsr_dispatch` tool that run headless `opencode run` as fresh-context, cross-vendor worker backends, with a Python driver for watchdog timeouts and per-worker output files. Windows only (Windows PowerShell): requires the OpenCode CLI, Python 3 and a model allowlist at `~/.ocsr/allowed-models.json`.
description.zh: 提供 `ocsr` 技能与 `ocsr_dispatch` 工具，把 headless `opencode run` 当作 fresh-context、跨厂商的 worker 后端；超时看门狗与每 worker 产物文件由 Python driver 负责。仅支持 Windows（需 Windows PowerShell）；需本机安装 OpenCode CLI、Python 3，并在 `~/.ocsr/allowed-models.json` 配置模型白名单。

description.en: Local-first task workbench for DeepSeek Harness with today, week and all-task views, single-day and multi-day tasks with optional times, a four-state idea pool, and daily/weekly/monthly reviews that only a human can write.
description.zh: 本地优先的任务工作台：今日/本周/任务总表、当天与跨周期任务（可选时间）、四态想法池，以及日/周/月复盘；复盘正文只能人写，AI 只读。

description.en: [FROZEN 2026-10-31] Freight ratecard versioning, carrier bill audit, recovery summary and variance export.
description.zh: 管理运费费率版本、审核承运商账单，并汇总差异与追回金额。

description.en: Drive the desktop and Chrome from DeepSeek Harness using the computer-use runtime inside the ChatGPT desktop application.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 LCU 直接操控桌面和 Chrome，不用打开应用就能自动干活。

description.en: uni-app x 打包流水线：npm 可安装 CLI + DeepSeek Harness 插件（iOS / Android / HarmonyOS，macOS 全功能，Windows/Linux 走 Git Bash 或 WSL）
description.zh: 一条命令打包 uni-app x 应用，iOS、安卓、鸿蒙全支持，Mac 上开箱即用。

description.en: One toggle makes the whole DeepSeek Harness shell translucent, with an opacity slider and a custom full-page background.
description.zh: 一键让整个 DeepSeek Harness 界面通透起来：透明度滑块随心调，背景图自由换。
